_about: Ethanol (1) + p-Xylene (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of ethanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of ethanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: M. D. C. Sanchez-Russinyol, A. Aucejo, S. Loras, Isobaric Vapor-Liquid Equilibria for Binary and Ternary Mixtures of Ethanol, Methylcyclohexane and p-Xylene, J. Chem. Eng. Data 49 (2004) 1258-1262
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 14, 15. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0085. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
